Suppression
Switch it off and every pixel above the threshold is its own box: dozens stacked on each face. The notebook's loop keeps the highest score, zeroes every score under that box, and repeats until nothing is left above the threshold.

    
No threshold is right
At 0.59 the search finds three faces and puts two boxes on a belt and a skirt. The center man scores at best 0.542 and the woman on the right 0.534, so catching all five takes 0.53, which also returns 12 false alarms. At 0.61 the false alarms are gone, and so is every face but one.

    
What is measured
The score map is the notebook's: cv.matchTemplate with TM_CCOEFF_NORMED on the padded photo, best over 15 scales and 20 angles. The suppression loop runs in the page and reproduces the notebook's five boxes at 0.59. The five face boxes were marked by hand.
